port_difficulty.why: One MOVE of a constant into SH-CUST-ID, then GOBACK. No arithmetic, no I/O, no branching.

blast_radius.why: It reads and writes no dataset and nothing calls it, so a wrong port cannot damage another unit in this tree. Whether it sits in the nightly batch cycle is unknown, because the tree holds no JCL or scheduler.

units.driving_fact: It includes SHARED01 (the same layout PROGB includes, with a COMP-3 balance field) but only touches SH-CUST-ID.
